title: MorphoStat: an automated pipeline for normalisation, assumption-aware statistics, and publication-ready visualisation of cell morphology profiles
description: MorphoStat is a Python package and command-line tool that turns morphology tables exported by CellProfiler, Fiji/ImageJ or FilamentSensor into cleaned, plate-normalised data, assumption-aware statistics with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR control, publication-ready figures, and an auditable run report. Version 0.1.2 is the version described in the accompanying Bio-protocol article; run_validation.py reproduces the BBBC021 validation reported there.
